description: Shared Renovate preset for the sharkops-io and example GitHub orgs, extended by each org's org-inherited-config.json. Ported from the GitLab runner's default.json (example-org/renovate); the GitLab-only rules stay there until the deploy repos move.
minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour 'timestamp-optional' only governs dependencies whose datasource returns no releaseTimestamp (common for OCI charts); it does not make the 1-day wait advisory.

packageRules.description: sharkops-io publishes nothing until a tag, so minor/patch bumps automerge once checks pass (carried over from the GitLab sharkops/** rule). NOT sharkops-io/.github: its reusable workflows run in every repo, the same reason gitlab-ci-common-config was excluded on GitLab.
